analysis.reason: RSI가 33.0으로 과매도 구간에 진입했으며, MACD 히스토그램은 -0.0001로 악화되며 약세 수렴을 지속 중이다. 5일 연속 음봉으로 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.75배로 위축되어 매수세 유입이 미약하다. 52주 저가인 $0.07 지지선이 유효하나, SMA200 대비 -13.89% 하락한 상태로 추가 하락 가능성을 배제할 수 없다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI is at 33.0, entering oversold territory, while the MACD histogram has worsened to -0.0001, continuing weak convergence. With five consecutive down days and volume at 0.75x the 5-day average, buying interest is weak. The 52-week low support at $0.07 is holding, but the price is still -13.89% below the SMA200, indicating potential for further decline.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($0.07) vs SMA5/20/50 ($0.08/$0.08/$0.08): Below short-to-mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($0.08/$0.09): Below long-term moving averages, indicating trend weakening.
· 52-week position (5.2%) + Historical significance near the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.4→33.0): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0000→-0.0001): Weakness persists, suggesting potential for further decline.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $0.07): Approaching the lower band, exploring potential for a bounce.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.07): Based on 52-week low and Pivot S1, a zone for attempting a short-term bounce.
· Swing resistance ($0.08): SMA5/20/50 and Pivot R1; a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed): Confirming a sideways range, lacking trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): Below the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold and 52-week low support confirmed; requires observation while seeking buying opportunities.
